description: Eligibility criteria related knowledge for MERI MBA and PGDM Admission Voice Agent.

faqs.answer: Candidates must have a recognized Bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate marks. Students appearing in the final year of their graduation may also apply, subject to the applicable admission guidelines.

examples: How many marks are required in graduation?
What is the minimum graduation percentage?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in their Bachelor's degree to be eligible for admission as per the published eligibility criteria.

examples: I have less than 50 percent in graduation.
faqs.answer: As per the published eligibility criteria, candidates are required to have a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in graduation. If your graduation marks are below 50%, you would not meet the current eligibility criteria for admission.
Yes. Students appearing in the final year of their Bachelor's degree may apply, subject to the applicable admission guidelines and fulfilment of the eligibility requirements.
Candidates with a recognized Bachelor's degree in any discipline who meet the minimum eligibility criteria may apply for admission.
A Bachelor's degree meeting the minimum eligibility criteria is required. Please contact the admissions team for the latest information regarding any additional admission requirements.
The published eligibility information primarily specifies the academic qualification requirements. For any age-related admission policies, please contact the admissions team.

examples: What is the eligibility for reserved category?
Is there any relaxation for SC?
faqs.answer: Eligibility and reservation policies are governed by the applicable university and admission guidelines. Please contact the admissions team for the latest category-specific eligibility details.
